source: flybody fruit fly model (TuragaLab/flybody, Google DeepMind & HHMI Janelia), fruitfly.xml + per-part OBJ meshes; body tree and node names are flybody body names
license: Model geometry: Apache-2.0 (flybody). Motion data: Apache-2.0 (FlyGym v2 Spotlight sample clip; NeuroMechFly v1 DeepFly3D grooming data). See README.md.

units.length: 1.0 = fly body length, head front to abdomen tip

playback_note: Real-data clips (walk, groom) run 4x slower than real time at playback rate 1 (set timeScale=4 for real time). idle is in natural time. flap is one wing-beat cycle; real flies beat ~200 Hz, so play it as fast as you like.

walk.data: REAL recorded: freely walking fly (Spotlight rig, EPFL Neuroengineering lab), 3D leg keypoints from FlyGym v2 spotlight_behavior_clip.npz, retargeted to flybody legs by IK; seamless loop cut from the recording (small end mismatch blended out); body root held in place

groom.data: REAL recorded: tethered fly antennal/head grooming (optogenetic aDN activation), NeuroMechFly v1 DeepFly3D 3D pose, front legs retargeted to flybody by IK; mid/hind legs held in the standing pose; loop cut from the recording

idle.data: PROCEDURAL: small head, antenna, haltere and abdomen-breathing motion; legs planted

flap.data: PROCEDURAL: one cycle of flybody's built-in approximate wing-beat pattern (WingBeatPatternGenerator default; the measured pattern is in the GPL figshare dataset, not used); wings only

rest_pose: flybody default standing pose; wings folded over the abdomen and proboscis retracted (joint springref)
